title: I shared my voxel game here about two days ago, and here's how much it's changed.
author: Affectionate_Tie6915
selftext:
Hey everyone, I posted an early version of this game here two days ago and ended up spending quite a bit more time working on it since then. Figured I'd share another update because it's already starting to come together pretty nicely.

I've been focusing on \[mention the 2–3 biggest improvements shown in the video\]. Still trying to get the core gameplay and overall feel right before moving on to some of the bigger features I have planned.

I've been using Claude to help with development and experimenting with different approaches as I go. A lot of it has honestly just been testing things, seeing what works, fixing what doesn't, and repeating that process until everything starts feeling right.

Anyway, I put together a quick video showing the progress so far. It's definitely still early, and there's plenty left to improve, but it's been pretty interesting seeing how much can change in just a day.

Would love to hear what you guys think of the direction so far, especially what you'd improve or add next.
